remarks: A welcoming covered front porch, mature trees and a stone walkway set the tone for this charming single story home in an established Canyon Country neighborhood. With 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and approximately 1,040 square feet of living space, the home pairs an easy one level layout with thoughtful updates throughout. The remodeled kitchen features quartz countertops with a matching quartz backsplash and a gas range, while both bathrooms have been remodeled with updated finishes. A wood burning fireplace with a gas starter adds warmth and character to the living area, and additional improvements reported by the sellers include a newer roof, newer HVAC system and tankless water heater.
